answer: A diversity gate stops bulk fakes. Each vertex must trade with 12 unrelated counterparties across 3 clusters before full rewards. No operator can bridge its own fakes into credibility: trades inside one lagoon of sockpuppets count as one counterparty, and a star cluster is frozen. Forging 100 identities needs 1,200 genuine trades; at 2 days of earnings each, that costs 2,400 days. An honest agent pays 12 trades once and keeps undiluted rewards.
